title: NeuroDataSets: A Comprehensive Collection of Neuroscience and Brain-Related Datasets
text: NeuroDataSets package offers rich diverse collection datasets focused brain, nervous system, neurological psychiatric disorders. includes comprehensive data conditions Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, epilepsy, schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorder, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), Tourette’s syndrome, traumatic brain injury, gliomas, migraines, headaches, sleep disorders, concussions, encephalitis, subarachnoid hemorrhage, mental health conditions. package contains wide variety data types, including clinical, experimental, neuroimaging, behavioral, cognitive, simulated datasets. datasets encompass structural functional brain data, cross-sectional longitudinal MRI imaging studies, neurotransmission metrics, gene expression profiles, cognitive performance assessments, intelligence metrics, sleep deprivation effects, treatment outcomes, brain-body relationships across species, neurological injury patterns, acupuncture interventions. Designed researchers, neuroscientists, clinicians, psychologists, data scientists, students, package facilitates exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning applications, hypothesis testing neuroscience neuroepidemiology.
